newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - November 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - November 19.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Tuesday's edition of Daily Variety:
HOLLYWOOD - Sony Corp said it had no plans of selling its studio operations but it still wanted to take it public.
NEW YORK - For the second time in a month, leading satcaster DirecTV Inc of Hughes Electronics Inc said it would not break even next year.
